background: NBK International is the London-based bank of National Bank of Kuwait, the largest bank in Kuwait, serving the parent's Gulf clients in Europe with private banking, trade finance and property lending, funded by deposits and the parent.
synthesis: Ratings are A+ from Fitch and A+ from S&P after its upgrade on 25 Nov 2025, both stable, resting on the Kuwaiti parent. Capital is strong against UK mid-sized banks, with CET1 of 20.4% and leverage of 13.2% both in the top quarter against medians of 13.9% and 7.4%. Liquidity is mixed: LCR of 497% is in the top quarter, while NSFR of 120% is in the bottom quarter against 135% and has fallen 7 points since 31 Dec 2024. Leverage has risen 1.1 points and LCR 67 points over the same period. The figures run to 31 Dec 2025. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
